cards.name: Astarion's Thirst
cards.oracleText: Exile target creature. Put X +1/+1 counters on a commander creature you control, where X is the power of the creature exiled this way.

cards.name: Blood Lust
cards.oracleText: If target creature has toughness 5 or greater, it gets +4/-4 until end of turn. Otherwise, it gets +4/-X until end of turn, where X is its toughness minus 1.

cards.name: Bloodthirster
cards.oracleText:
Flying, trample
Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, untap it. After this phase, there is an additional combat phase.
This creature can't attack a player it has already attacked this turn.

cards.name: Bloodchief's Thirst
cards.oracleText:
Kicker {2}{B} (You may pay an additional {2}{B} as you cast this spell.)
Destroy target creature or planeswalker with mana value 2 or less. If this spell was kicked, instead destroy target creature or planeswalker.

cards.name: Cankerous Thirst
cards.oracleText: If {B} was spent to cast this spell, you may have target creature get -3/-3 until end of turn. If {G} was spent to cast this spell, you may have target creature get +3/+3 until end of turn. (Do both if {B}{G} was spent.)

cards.name: Eternal Thirst
cards.oracleText:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature has lifelink and "Whenever a creature an opponent controls dies, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature." (Damage dealt by a creature with lifelink also causes its controller to gain that much life.)

cards.name: Infectious Bloodlust
cards.oracleText:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature gets +2/+1, has haste, and attacks each combat if able.
When enchanted creature dies, you may search your library for a card named Infectious Bloodlust, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

cards.name: Necromantic Thirst
cards.oracleText:
Enchant creature
Whenever enchanted creature deals combat damage to a player, you may return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.

cards.name: Nightmare's Thirst
cards.oracleText: You gain 1 life. Target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn, where X is the amount of life you gained this turn.

cards.name: Thirst for Meaning
cards.oracleText: Draw three cards. Then discard two cards unless you discard an enchantment card.

cards.name: Sorin's Thirst
cards.oracleText: Sorin's Thirst deals 2 damage to target creature and you gain 2 life.

cards.name: Thirst for Knowledge
cards.oracleText: Draw three cards. Then discard two cards unless you discard an artifact card.

cards.name: Thirst for Discovery
cards.oracleText: Draw three cards. Then discard two cards unless you discard a basic land card.

cards.name: Unquenchable Thirst
cards.oracleText:
Enchant creature
When this Aura enters, if you control a Desert or there is a Desert card in your graveyard, tap enchanted creature.
Enchanted creature doesn't untap during its controller's untap step.

cards.name: Thirst
cards.oracleText:
Enchant creature
When this Aura enters, tap enchanted creature.
Enchanted creature doesn't untap during its controller's untap step.
At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice this Aura unless you pay {U}.
